title: Shared bit cores and gauged scratch reuse: conditional κ = 1.29186205798e-4
body:
**κ = 1.29186205798e-4 = 64593102899/500000000000000.**

κ ≈ 129186205798/10¹⁵ > 2⁻¹³.

This is a verified historical checkpoint. Later three-stage-cover candidates [PR130](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/130) and [PR131](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/131) give larger conditional savings.

Under the retained stopped-product, endpoint, analytic and fixed-tape interfaces, this finite conditional witness supports T(n) = O(n(log n)^(1−κ)). This is **4.19234% above PR114's checked `7722755` checkpoint** and **4.94411% above PR128's pinned `530588a` claim**. These comparisons refer to those exact checkpoints; the PR list was checked through #128 immediately before submission.

The improvement combines a new **161-group bit partition** with **physical operation frames, compensated birth-cut reuse and gauged completed-core sharing** on the complex side. The stopped ordinary-bit saving now binds the final assembly.

| Supplier | Shared bit | Shared complex |
|---|---:|---:|
| dimension | 529 | 576 |
| physical local scratch roles | 28,866 | 26,597 |
| completed-core groups | 161 | 87 |
| original streams W | 15,567,734 | 12,821,030 |
| total recursive rank | 8,233,987,097 | 7,383,051,200 |
| rank deficit | 1,344,189 | 1,862,080 |
| largest child | 518 | 560 |
| certified supplier saving | 129310447/10¹² (coarse) | 130696544/10¹² |

The retained stopping fraction yields the actual ordinary-bit saving **129219596453/10¹⁵**. Exact assembly pays the scalar work, adapters, all three row stocks and the remaining margins to obtain the stated κ.

The bit construction partitions all 1,771 triples of 23 coordinates into **161 common-center sunflower classes of eleven**. Seven base classes are translated through Z/23Z; an exact orbit-orientation search and seven perfect matchings supply the witness. Under H = 9I−J, distinct triples in a class have annihilating rational projectors. Whole completed cores can therefore share each dirty scratch role, with a paid complement of rank `529 − 11*(23−dim σ)`. The package reconstructs and replays PR128's pinned minimal-V scalar schedule; it does not claim to regenerate the unpublished optimizer that selected that schedule. Every old internal/data/copy/endpoint child and **659,476,769 projector adapter calls** remains paid. A single common rational basis is selected for the enlarged finite projector family, followed by a fixed odd execution prime avoiding its finite bad-prime set; the verification prime alone is not an execution-prime certificate.

The complex construction retains PR117's **91,770 additions and 71,185 carrier links**, optimizes frames at physical operations and uses PR124's compensation to reuse **2,108 dead slots**. The literal source/workspace word is undone in true reverse chronology and restores every physical scratch slot for arbitrary dirty inputs. Its 470 distinct initial frames include 2,598 nonzero-gauge slots. PR128's signed partition supplies 83 groups of 24 and four of eight. Each group-role pays the actual complement `576 − |J|*(24−dim σ)`, with exact Gaussian phases checked in both orientations, including alternating blocks. All core children and signed group exteriors remain charged.

The core scalar guard uses all **28,705 virtual roles**, because aliased readouts still occur. The separate basis/phase reserve uses the **26,597 physical roles** and pays 64m² wrapper atoms per group-role in each orientation. These are inherited ordinary-bit adapter calls, not constant-time tape instructions. The total scalar/semantic guard is **158614225569472**, row coefficient **1644**, and row degree **4000**. Modular address denominators do not add Gaussian decoder divisions to the retained exact 21-grid.

**Validation at current head `59fade1`:** the full local aggregate passes, and all **39 current-head CI checks pass**, including focused verification on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14. Regeneration covers the complete bit geometry and all-column replay of **1,076,483 events over 32,408 formal columns**, the physically aliased complex compiler, literal forward/reflected audit, signed partition, physical gauges, exact certificate and all **33 outer corruption controls**. All **47 strict constraints**, **seven margins** and next-grid exclusions pass; the original source tree stays unchanged. The frozen closure binds 69 package files and 20 repository dependencies. Proof profiles contain exact integer/rational records and reproduce with full equality; the canonical reflection receipt is also checked byte for byte. The numerical claim, physical words and complete paid histograms are unchanged from submission.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 research/cyclic-deferred/verify.py
make verify
```

The read-only aggregate regenerates both suppliers, actual scalar/reflection ledgers, physical source gauges, phases, complete profiles, exact certificate and controls in a temporary copy. `BITSHARING.md` and `SHARING.md` give the allocation/operator arguments. Finite checks do not prove the inherited common-basis, normal-form, transparency, ordinary-bit transfer, precision, streaming, routing, analytic, prime, recovery or fixed-tape interfaces. This remains a conditional finite witness, with no practical runtime or global-optimality claim.
